goal: bn-integration: normal-start opening, seed 103: gather, nation, found, recruit, order a Stranger member, Pay with Coins.

findings.title: Settlement screen shows two coin prices for the same farm
findings.detail: Buildings line: 'Next: Farm, 25 wood, 10 stone, or 2,160 coins'. With Pay with Coins on, the button reads 'Buy Farm (1,764)'. The code means it (full price vs. the price of the shortfall after carried wood/stone), but nothing on screen says why they differ.

findings.title: Pay with Coins is out of reach in the opening
findings.detail: At the first visit the player has 211 coins; Buy House is 1,584 and Buy Farm 1,764. Both buttons stay greyed ('Needs 1,584 coins; you have 211.'). Fine as a late-game option, but it does nothing for a new player.

findings.title: Build Stall keeps its 'Build' label in coin mode, with no tooltip
findings.detail: With Pay with Coins on, House and Farm become 'Buy X (price)' but Stall stays 'Build Stall', greyed, with no hover reason.

findings.title: Order button vanishes while the pawn walks away
findings.detail: Ordering a Stranger member works: Dave Davies (Stranger) says 'I hardly know you, but you lead Northernfield. I'll gather 10 wood.' But members walk out of reach between the approach and the click (at 5 fps), the Order row disappears and the click lands on nothing. It took 3 tries over two pawns.

findings.title: Own members still read '(Stranger)' on Talk
findings.detail: Oscar Robinson, a member who had just sworn fealty, shows 'Talk to Oscar Robinson (Stranger)'. The new Order flavour text makes this deliberate, but it still looks contradictory next to 'swore fealty'.

findings.title: Hover tooltip on the greyed Found Settlement drops the open-ground hint
findings.detail: Tapping the button gives the full status: '...Open ground lies about 200 paces to the south-east.' The hover tooltip stops at '...must be 250 paces apart.' and lies across the Leave Nation button and the Player Info box.

findings.title: Inventory box jumps to mid-screen when the command bar grows
findings.detail: With 3-4 command rows near a pawn, Inventory Info moves to x~220,y~230 and floats over the world. Inside a settlement it covers the Chronicle lines and the settlement nameplate.

metrics.openGroundHintFollowed: twice (SE, then SW); second hint led straight to a valid site

verdict: The opening works end to end. The open-ground hint gets you to a valid site, ordering a Stranger member works, and Pay with Coins toggles cleanly. The rough edges are price wording and buttons that move or vanish at low fps.
